title: MoMaTune: Model, Match, Then Tune Language Models for Numerical Records
abstract: arXiv:2610.15235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite remarkable progress in language understanding and generation, decoder language models continue to exhibit striking failures on numerical data. Numerical examples are typically serialized as text by concatenating feature names with their values (e.g., fat:3.4), while conventional task adaptation applies loss only to the downstream prediction target. This leaves two structures weakly supervised: within-value sensitivity, where digit position determines numerical magnitude, because token cross-entropy contains no explicit numerical metric; and across-field structure, where measurements in the same record are statistically dependent, because target-only tuning provides no direct loss on the measurements or their dependencies. We introduce MoMaTune (Model, Match, then Tune), a two-stage post-training strategy organized around these supervision gaps. translated_title: MoMaTune：面向数值记录的语言模型建模、匹配与微调方法
translated_abstract: 尽管在语言理解与生成方面取得了显著进展，解码器语言模型在数值数据上仍然表现出明显的缺陷。数值样本通常通过将特征名与特征值拼接（例如 fat:3.4）的方式序列化为文本，而传统的任务适配仅对下游预测目标施加损失。这导致两类结构处于弱监督状态：其一是数值内部敏感性，即数字所在位置决定数值大小，但词元交叉熵中并不包含显式的数值度量；其二是跨字段结构，即同一记录中的各测量值在统计上相互依赖，但仅针对目标的微调对这些测量值本身及其依赖关系不提供直接的损失。我们提出了 MoMaTune（Model, Match, then Tune，即建模、匹配、微调），一种围绕这些监督缺口设计的两阶段后训练策略。阶段一应用 Model（建模），在无标签的序列化文本上进行密集的普通下一词元预测……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MoMaTune 提出一种两阶段后训练策略，针对语言模型处理数值数据时的两大监督缺口——数值内部敏感性与跨字段依赖结构——依次进行建模、匹配与微调，从而提升模型对数值记录的理解能力。
en_tdlr: MoMaTune is a two-stage post-training strategy that addresses two supervision gaps in decoder language models on numerical data—within-value digit sensitivity and cross-field statistical dependencies—through a Model, Match, then Tune pipeline to improve numerical record understanding.
